macro.m_description: Notification patti ka tile 1 (ya home shortcut): pehle naye unsaved number (call / WhatsApp) ki list — 📇 Save karo (Naya contact screen) ya 💬 WhatsApp; aakhir mein ✍️ koi aur number likhein / paste karein -> WhatsApp mein us number ki chat, number save kiye baghair. Paigham wahin likh kar Send aap khud. AI nahi.

m_actionList.message:
📇 Naye number (call / WhatsApp — save nahi)
Save karo = naam likh kar Save · WhatsApp = chat khulegi

m_actionList.m_userPromptMessage: Number likhein ya paste karein (0300… ya +92…). OK = WhatsApp mein chat khulegi.

m_actionList.m_messageText: ❌ Number samajh nahi aaya — dobara 💬 dabayein
